1. Use HTTP/1.1 for WebSocket connection (browser automatic)
2. Have the client use wss:// via HTTP/1.1

The real fix is: Make the client connect via an HTTP/1.1 endpoint OR fix the client code to properly handle HTTP/2 WebSocket.
